source: Numeric values digitised in KherveFitting (G. Kerherve), file KherveFitting_library.json, https://github.com/gkerherve/KherveFitting (commit 8b2fdb980d6b0e54353513eb465fce69f42cebf3, sha256 77a87899c9aa9f1d98760d07321f2fa88307d8c83189ab2fbf5e1e726d602ef8). Library A-ALSCOF / A-MGSCOF = J.H. Scofield, "Hartree-Slater subshell photoionization cross-sections at 1254 and 1487 eV", J. Electron Spectrosc. Relat. Phenom. 8, 129-137 (1976), doi:10.1016/0368-2048(76)80015-1, relative to C 1s; A-ALTHERMO1 = Thermo Fisher Scientific Avantage "ALTHERMO1" sensitivity-factor library (Al Ka). Auger kinetic energies in the A-* libraries are those of the Avantage element tables.
notes: Only numeric facts are extracted (GPL code is not used). Keys are "Sym_orbital" as in the source; photoelectron "pos" = Avantage element-table position, used ONLY for survey peak identification (coarse representative values, e.g. O 1s 532.9, Ta 4f 25); core-level energies for display and doublet splittings come from the X-ray Data Booklet. C-Any / ScientaC1s-Ga Auger positions have no stated provenance and are used only as a secondary consistency reference, never as output values.
